title: Gatekeeper of Souls compels targets chosen outside battle
summary: Printed: "When a player selects targets for an effect during battle, I must be targeted if able." The engine applies the compulsion by region only, so in deployment a player whose own Gatekeeper stands in their home region can only aim a unit-targeting effect (Overbloom) at the Gatekeeper. Measured by the round-1 verifier's probe. (Measured by a verifier probe; the probe files are not committed.)

title: A deployment graft onto Mohruung is attached before Mohruung's trigger resolves
summary: The designer: grafting onto Mohruung, "he will trigger first". The engine fires the targeted event, attaches the graft at once, and only then resolves the queued trigger: the round-2 verifier's probe logs "Flame Juggle grafts onto Mohruung" before "Resolving Mohruung: create a Crystal 2". The RAQ guard (393 point 5) asserts only that a Crystal is made, not the order. Pending D-U03-13. (Measured by a verifier probe; the probe files are not committed.)

closed: fixed on 2026-10-22 (CT-242; owner "Resolves first", D-U03-13): the graft, and a deployment augment, attach after Mohruung's trigger resolves (547, 576).

title: Enigmatic Warder can be activated at an effect it could never be a legal target of
summary: Caleb (1403796597896253511): 'you can change any spell where warder could be a legal target'. The engine lets Warder's [two] ability aim at any stack effect, including a targetless trigger (511 'CT-306 Enigmatic Warder at a targetless trigger') or an effect whose every slot Warder cannot fill; it then pays [two] for nothing after a confirm. Under Caleb's criterion those effects should not be offered to Warder at all. Gravitational Correction / Divine Intervention are covered by the owner call and are not part of this.

evidence.quote: g.ev('info', `Enigmatic Warder: no target of ${item.label} may legally be changed to ${me.card}.`);
const CHANGERS = allCardNames().filter(n => /\bchange (?:a|the) targets? of target effect\b/i.test(getCard(n).text ?? ''));

closed: fixed on 2026-10-21: Enigmatic Warder's ability now targets only an effect with a target Warder could legally be (Caleb, RQ 1403796597896253511); 530 shows a targetless trigger and effects it cannot fill are not offered, while Gravitational Correction and Divine Intervention still are.
